title: The Skewed Heading
logline: A harbor dockmaster suspects a salvage crew is intentionally recalibrating navigational approach buoys to ground heavy ore transports on a gravitational reef.

roles.description: Chief of inbound space traffic; underslept, fiercely protective of docking crews, tracking a disturbing spike in hull fractures.
Skipper of a heavy deep-space recovery tug; weathered, practical, viewing navigational disasters as the natural harvest of space.
The competitive scrapper collective licensed under system salvage registry charters.
A massive reinforced hauler equipped with heavy tractor grapples and cutting lasers.
A dense field of magnetized asteroids trapped in a tight planetary Lagrange gravity well.
The orbital nerve center governing approach vectors and navigational beacon arrays for the inner system.

public_situation: Three heavy ore freighters have suffered catastrophic navigational lock failures near {role:gravity_reef}, leaving their hulls shattered across the rocks.
private_truth: {role:salvage_captain} has been altering the frequency offset on the reef approach beacon so autopilots overcompensate for tidal drift and steer directly into asteroid shears.

beats.public_change: {role:harbor_dockmaster} declares emergency repair priority for approach telemetry after another transport clips the reef.

missions.reason: He needs high-purity cuprite delivered to rebuild burnt-out waveguide circuits in the central traffic relay before more freighters drift off course.
missions.private_fact: He secretly suspects station engineers were bribed to ignore the drift warnings and needs outside ore to bypass the dock warehouse.

beats.public_change: The repaired relay reveals that the reef beacon is transmitting false magnetic offsets; {role:harbor_dockmaster} dispatches a survey probe.

missions.reason: He needs an armed pilot to scan the outer marker buoys and extract the physical transmitter logs before someone deletes the spoofed broadcast record.
missions.private_fact: The station manager ordered him to bury the inquiry because {role:salvage_syndicate} pays the port's docking deficit.

beats.public_change: An automated spoof transmitter drone deploys near the reef, guarded by unmarked privateer pickets.

missions.reason: He needs the drone picket destroyed and the transmitter's encrypted memory core recovered to prove the beacon frequency was altered deliberately.
missions.private_fact: The dockmaster's younger brother was chief engineer on the last freighter wrecked in the rocks.

beats.public_change: {role:salvage_tug} moves to hook the newest stranded bulk carrier while emergency docking sirens wail across the sector.

missions.reason: He needs the salvage tug disabled before it can strip the stranded vessel's life support core to fabricate a total loss claim.
missions.private_fact: The salvage captain hails mid-combat offering a thirty percent split of the derelict's refined copper cargo in exchange for withdrawing.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the salvage tug and secures the transmitter proof.
resolutions.summary: {role:salvage_captain} is arrested at the berth. The approach buoys are restored to true frequencies, ending the string of fabricated reef groundings.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot hunted down the salvage tug that was rigging orbital beacons to smash freighters into the reef.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the salvage captain's cargo split and leaves the tug to finish the salvage.
resolutions.summary: The stranded ore hauler is stripped to the ribs. {role:salvage_captain} escapes prosecution, and {role:harbor_dockmaster} is forced into early retirement.

consequences.public_summary: Rumor has it a mercenary took a hold full of stolen copper to let the reef scavengers finish their work.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the combat missions or ignores the dockmaster's calls.
resolutions.summary: The tampered beacon remains uncorrected. Two more bulk carriers run aground on the reef, cementing {role:salvage_syndicate}'s dominance over emergency repair contracts.

loose_threads.detail: The exchange board lists forward salvage options for the wrecked freighter's scrap iron purchased six days before the vessel lost navigational lock.
The firmware hash on the reef beacon's transmitter matches a security patch code registered to an offshore corporate shell with no active crew.
The registration stencils on {role:salvage_tug} mask an older naval hull identifier that was reported scuttled during the previous colonial insurrection.

radio_hooks: Traffic control reports third hull failure this month in the {role:gravity_reef} approach.
{role:salvage_syndicate} defends rapid response salvage times, calling accusations 'insulting'.
Miners protest rising freight insurance rates following repeated navigational losses.

voice_direction.harbor_dockmaster: Hoarse, clipped, and visibly fraying under stress. Barking concise flight instructions between bouts of bitter profanity regarding dockside safety.
voice_direction.salvage_captain: Slow, gravelly drawl with an easy, unhurried warmth. Talks about twisted wreckage and drowning crews with the nonchalant detachment of a grain farmer discussing a harvest.
